outcome: The bounded authoring languages now share a generic standard scientific mathematics substrate with ordinary exponentiation syntax
owner_impact: Controller, Initialization, Metrics and scalar Environment expressions can use ** plus abs, sqrt, exp, log, trigonometric/inverse-trigonometric functions, atan2, floor/ceil, pow and min/max without filing language capability requests. Existing source remains valid; ** lowers to the same native power operation as pow. Non-finite literals are rejected before persistence and non-finite Controller actions fail loudly instead of silently corrupting simulation state. No scientific capability became authorable.

next.text: Next is #385 — Metrics control flow and comparisons, bringing the bounded boolean/comparison/if substrate already available in Controller to Metrics. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: Browser and MCP compiler copies remain mirrored for Controller, Initialization, Metrics and Environment.
Rust Controller, Metrics and Environment runtimes implement the advertised scalar functions with native f64 operations.
Exponentiation ** is parsed with Python-style unary precedence and lowered to pow rather than introducing another numerical path.
Regression coverage spans all four artifact languages, runtime math, right-associative exponentiation and non-finite literal rejection.
No scientific capability, candidate availability, MCP tool count, CI/CD, polling, retry, timeout or development-workflow rule changed.
